factValues.name: gr:fact-b82503ab68ed9bf7_fv
factValues.value: For the period ended 30 September 2025 the company was entitled to exemption from audit under section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 relating to small companies.

factValues.name: gr:fact-3e03157fb5280beb_fv
factValues.value: The members have not required the company to obtain an audit of its accounts for the period in question in accordance with section 476 of the Companies Act 2006.

factValues.name: gr:fact-c54ed852333af08e_fv
factValues.value: The directors acknowledge their responsibilities for complying with the requirements of the Companies Act 2006 with respect to accounting records and the preparation of accounts.

factValues.name: gr:fact-8b3287c8a9fc5a9c_fv
factValues.value: The accounts have been prepared in accordance with the micro-entity provisions and delivered in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies subject to the small companies regime.

factValues.name: gr:fact-b0cb114d4627e049_fv
factValues.value: The financial statements are prepared under the historical cost convention and in accordance with the FRS 105 Financial Reporting Standard for Micro Entities (effective January 2016).
